stem: After a typhoon, an official repacks donated relief goods into bags printed with a politician's name, to make the goods look like they came from that politician. Under Section 19 of RA 10121, what is this?
choices: Prohibited, as it misrepresents the goods' source
Allowed, as long as the goods reach the victims
Allowed, if the politician gave written consent
Prohibited only if the goods are already spoiled
answer: Prohibited, as it misrepresents the goods' source
hints: Section 19 of RA 10121 lists prohibited acts about relief goods. One group is about giving a false picture of where the goods came from.
Look at Section 19(i), "Misrepresenting the source of relief goods," and the three ways it lists.
Item (i)(2) covers repacking goods "into containers with different markings to make it appear that the goods came from another agency or persons." Compare it with the facts.

solution.methodName: Check the act against the law's list of prohibited acts

steps.action: Recall Section 19(i) of RA 10121: "Misrepresenting the source of relief goods, equipment or other aid commodities" is a prohibited act.
steps.why: To misrepresent means to give a false picture of something.

steps.action: Read the second way it lists: repacking goods "into containers with different markings to make it appear that the goods came from another agency or persons."
Apply it to the facts: the bags carry a politician's name so the goods look like they came from that person. This fits Section 19(i)(2). Delivery and consent do not change that.
The answer is prohibited, as it misrepresents the goods' source.

trapNotes.Allowed, as long as the goods reach the: Delivery does not make it right. Section 19(i) prohibits misrepresenting the source even if the goods reach the victims.
trapNotes.Allowed, if the politician gave written: Section 19 gives no exception for consent. The act is prohibited no matter who agrees to it.
trapNotes.Prohibited only if the goods are already: Spoilage is not part of this rule. Repacking to fake the source is prohibited even when the goods are in good condition.

sourceRef.citation: RA 10121 (Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010), Section 19(i)
